ValidationRule.description: The Subject on Account Management cases is typically set upon creation and is being used for reporting so shouldn't be changed. Prevent users from updating the Subject on Account Management cases from the original value, exclude Admins.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
/* Display error when Case record type is Account Management and the Subject is changed from a non-blank value, as long as the user is not an Admin*/
AND( RecordTypeId= "0121a000000EoXk", ISCHANGED(Subject), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Subject))), NOT( $Profile.Name = 'System Administrator') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Subject cannot be changed from the original on Account Management cases
